description: Adopts the shared Kataglyphis Renovate preset. Everything this repo needs is in there, so this file is deliberately one line of policy: the whole point of the preset is that consumers do not each carry their own copy of the rules.

What the preset adds beyond the defaults, and why it matters here: it ENABLES the git-submodules manager, which Renovate disables by default - that is why third_party/ANThology and third_party/ANTfrastructure have never had a gitlink bump proposed. Both entries in .gitmodules already carry `branch = main`, which is what the manager needs to know what to bump them to.

It also pins third-party GitHub Actions by digest (this repo currently references astral-sh/setup-uv and SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action by tag) while explicitly NOT proposing pins for Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure composite actions, which are resolved at @main on purpose for the upstream-first change flow.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ANTfrastructure` from ANTfrastructure's DEFAULT BRANCH, so a preset change only reaches this repo once it is merged there - not from the pin in third_party/ANTfrastructure.
